messages:
maria.lopez: Quick heads-up — product is sunsetting the v1 client next month. We need a short migration note + updated snippets across chat, streaming, and embeddings pages. Target: docs PRs merged by 2026-04-15.

samir: Do we plan to ship a compat shim in the 2.x SDK or just a migration guide?

maria.lopez: We'll include a basic compat shim for simple request/response usage (header compatibility + param mapping). No shim for streaming or function-calls — those need explicit v2 examples.

samir: Got it. I'll add a "compatibility" callout that explains limitations.

kevin: Heads-up on model name mapping — redwood-small -> rw/small-1 and redwood-embed -> rw/emb-large. Also embeddings billing unit changed (now per-768-dim chunk). Make sure we call that out in the embeddings migration note.

olivia: Should we add a short example converting the old embeddings call to the new one (show input vector size handling)? I can draft.

maria.lopez: Yes. Keep it tiny — one before/after snippet and a note about dimensionality/units.

	old v1 embeddings snippet:
	```js
	// v1 (old)
	client.embeddings({ model: 'redwood-embed', input: ['a', 'b'] })
	```

	new v2 embeddings snippet:
	```js
	// v2
	const resp = await rwClient.embeddings.create({ model: 'rw/emb-large', input: ['a', 'b'] })
	console.log(resp.data[0].embedding.length) // note dims -> billing units
	```

samir: For the chat snippets, we should show the change in call signature and highlight the new `X-RW-Client` header name (replaces `X-Client`).

maria.lopez: Good catch. Add a one-line note: `Headers: X-RW-Client: v2` and mention token scoping unchanged.

	v1 chat example:
	```js
	// v1
	client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-chat', messages: [...] })
	```

	v2 chat example:
	```js
	// v2
	const chat = await rwClient.chat.completions.create({ model: 'rw/chat-1', input: { messages: [...] } })
	```

taylor_w: I can open the PR for TS snippets + a short migration note. Will also add a small section explaining streaming caveats (no compat shim). ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria.lopez: Thanks — tag me as reviewer. PR link placeholder: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 (will update)

kevin: One more: the model fallback behavior changed when a pinned model is unavailable — we now return 409 with a specific `x-rw-fallback` code instead of silently routing. Add a note in the rollout/migration page about handling 409s and automated fallback tests.

olivia: I'll write the short troubleshooting bullet for 409 + sample retry logic.

maria.lopez: Action items:
- taylor_w: PR with TS/JS snippet swaps + header callout (owner)
- olivia: embeddings note + 409 troubleshooting bullet
- samir: compat callout text and limitations list
- kevin: model mapping table (tiny)

samir: Quick Q: do we also need to update quickstart snippets in README templates (they're used in starter repos)?

maria.lopez: Yes — update the starter template files under /examples/starter. Make sure the CLI example is still valid.

	CLI change example:
	```bash
	# v1
	rw-up --client v1 --model redwood-chat

	# v2
	rw-up --client v2 --model rw/chat-1
	```

doc-bot: deploy-bot: docs preview build scheduled for PR 789 once opened.

maria.lopez: Perfect — let's keep each PR scoped small. If anyone needs handoff for copy review or screenshots, ping me. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll assemble the model mapping table and push to the PR branch.

taylor_w: Will open PR and ping reviewers. Thanks all.

olivia: Drafting embeddings note now, will push in the next 2 hours.

maria.lopez: Closing loop — once PRs are merged, I'll update the deprecation notice with final dates and link to migration guide.
